description: Strategic upgrades: new music/avatar integrations, pipeline orchestration (Temporal, Dagster), cloud rendering (Remotion Lambda), distribution (Late API, Mux), and monitoring (LiteLLM).

userStories.title: Add Google Lyria RealTime music integration
userStories.description: Create library/music/lyria_realtime.py that generates music using Google's Lyria RealTime API via WebSocket. Lyria allows real-time steering of key, tempo, brightness, and mood in 2-second chunks — maps directly to our BPM_MAP architecture. Free via Gemini API.
acceptanceCriteria: Connects to Lyria RealTime via WebSocket (Gemini API)
Supports steering params: key, tempo, brightness, mood
Outputs WAV file compatible with the mixing pipeline
userStories.notes: Free via Gemini API. WebSocket-based real-time generation.

userStories.title: Add Beatoven.ai video-to-music API integration
userStories.description: Create library/music/beatoven.py that generates music using Beatoven.ai's API. Supports text-to-music and video-to-music with scene markers for mood shifts.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports text-to-music generation with mood/genre/tempo params
Supports video-to-music (upload video, get scored track)
Scene marker support for per-section mood control
userStories.notes: $100-200/yr. Scene markers map to our existing section structure.

userStories.title: Add Qwen3-TTS self-hosted voiceover provider

Supports voice cloning from 3-second reference audio
userStories.notes: Apache 2.0, zero marginal cost. GPU required.

userStories.title: Add MuseTalk open-source lip sync integration

Takes source image + audio, outputs lip-synced video
Output MP4 compatible with compositing pipeline
userStories.notes: Open source lip sync, ~$0.01-0.05/clip vs D-ID pricing.

userStories.title: Add Wan-Alpha RGBA video generation
userStories.description: Create library/pipeline/wan_alpha.py that generates native RGBA video (transparent background) using Wan-Alpha (CVPR 2026, open source). Replaces green_screen.py FFmpeg colorkey pipeline.

userStories.title: Add Temporal workflow for durable pipeline execution
userStories.description: Create library/pipeline/temporal_workflow.py wrapping the 6-phase pipeline as a Temporal workflow. Crash-safe, auto-retry, saga compensation, heartbeating for long polls.

userStories.notes: Free open source. Only re-render what changed.
